title: Judgment-skill I/O: excerpt files, passages, passages_checked
description: Three file shapes discriminated by 'kind'. (1) Excerpt files audit/excerpts/<skill>.json are each judgment specialist's single prepared input - one read, one judgment, one write, <=3 tool calls ; excerpts are bounded (<=1,500 chars per candidate location), never whole pages. (2) audit/passages.json is answer-coverage's output mapping generated questions to candidate answer passages. (3) audit/passages_checked.json is collect_snapshot.py --passages output: deterministic text-node contiguity per candidate passage (text-fragment landing survivability), read by referral-experience. NOTE for build_report.py's vendored validator: this schema uses oneOf and is dev-oracle-only; the runtime-validated schemas (output, fragment, snapshot) do not.

budget_chars.description: total excerpt budget for this skill's input file

pages_without_content.description: sampled page URLs with no extractable headings, excerpts, or claims — collapsed here instead of repeated as empty entries

extras.description: per-skill additions: referral-experience <- probes subset (soft_404, redirect_path_preservation) plus the passages_checked results; freshness-consistency <- sitemap lastmod summary + claim_index across pages; answer-coverage <- nothing extra; offsite-visibility <- the prompt set (written by the --passages post-step)

page_class.description: homepage, decision, docs, recent, about, product, trust, other

id.description: stable heading ids matter for the referral fragment/anchor checks

main_content_excerpts.description: candidate answer locations only - never the whole page

char_offset.description: offset into the page's visible_text, for evidence citation

claim_index_subset.description: claims from this page relevant to the target skill

count.description: repeated identical claims collapsed into one row (e.g. a date strip); quote is the first occurrence

sample_locations.description: up to 3 further locations of the repeated claim

page_stats.description: precomputed counts so judges never re-derive them from the snapshot

anchorable_runs.description: Extraction blocks a passage can be cut from as ONE contiguous run. Draw build_passages.py anchors from inside these: an anchor that is not inside a single run cannot resolve. A short list is itself evidence that commercial facts are stated in fragments (pair with REP-*).

repeats_on_pages.description: sibling sampled pages carrying the identical run; >1 means templated boilerplate, which anchors fine but is never a per-page fact

source.description: site-derived: what the site's own pages claim to answer; market-derived: what a category customer would ask regardless. Market-derived questions with no answering page feed opportunities[], not findings. The prompt set also drives offsite-visibility probes.

expected_page.description: the page that should answer this question

candidate_passage.description: verbatim from the page; omit the key (keep the entry) when the question is unanswered

qualifier_present.description: does the passage carry its own qualifications/exceptions?

source_location.description: heading path / char offset for evidence

anchor_status.description: resolved: build_passages.py extracted candidate_passage. unanswered: no anchor drafted - the site does not answer the question. unresolved: an anchor was drafted but could not be pinned to one contiguous run; a quoting/fragmentation signal, NEVER evidence that the question is unanswered.

contiguous.description: candidate_passage exists as a contiguous visible text run - within one text block or spanning two adjacent blocks (scroll-to-text range fragments match across block boundaries); interleaved headings still fail

note.description: e.g. 'price split across three spans', 'inside collapsed details'
